requirements.requirement: The system must define a typed UI contract object for board certification containing fields: certification_status, issuing_body, and score_contribution.
The system must constrain certification_status to a predefined enum set (e.g., certified, not_certified, unknown).
The system must define issuing_body as a string field with support for normalized display values.
The system must define score_contribution as a numeric field representing the contribution to overall provider score.
The system must ensure the UI contract is compatible with the data structure returned by backend feature EVAL-P-MEASURE-BOARD.
The system must ensure the UI contract can be consumed by MessageBubble.tsx without requiring structural transformation outside the component.
The system must define optional/null handling for issuing_body when backend data is missing.
The system must define a default fallback value for certification_status when backend data is absent or undefined.
The system must ensure score_contribution is bounded within an expected range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100) consistent with scoring standards.
The system must define the contract in a reusable type/interface that can be imported across frontend components.
The system must ensure the contract supports serialization/deserialization from JSON without loss of required fields.
The system must validate that all required fields (certification_status and score_contribution) are present before rendering.
The system must gracefully handle invalid certification_status values by mapping them to 'unknown'.
The system must handle exception where backend payload omits the entire certification object by providing a safe default contract.
The system must handle exception where score_contribution is non-numeric by coercing or rejecting the value according to contract validation rules.
